description:
About us:


Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂


Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.


Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.


The Role:


We are looking for a Senior MERN Stack Developer with heavy specialization in React.js and Node.js on behalf of one of our high-growth clients to architect, scale, and maintain high-throughput web applications. In this role, you will take operational ownership of both front-end user interfaces and back-end microservices, delivering seamless, secure, and responsive digital products. You will bridge user-facing features with complex database architectures and cloud infrastructure. You are a perfect candidate if you are growth-oriented, you love what you do, and you enjoy working on new ideas to develop exciting products


What we are looking for:


  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and deploying end-to-end applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js.
  • Deep proficiency in modern JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, asynchronous programming, event loops, and memory management across client and server environments.
  • Deep mastery of React internals, custom hooks, component design patterns, state management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or React Query), SSR/SSG frameworks (Next.js is a strong plus), and performance optimization (virtualization, code splitting, Web Vitals).
  • Proven experience architecting scalable RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and/or GraphQL services. Proficiency with middleware design, authentication protocols (JWT, OAuth2, Passport.js), and event-driven architectures.
  • Advanced knowledge of MongoDB schema design, aggregation pipelines, index strategy, performance tuning, and ORMs/ODMs like Mongoose or Prisma.
  • Strong commitment to test-driven development using frameworks like Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress, alongside hands-on experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), and AWS cloud services.
  • Time zone: CET (+/- 3 hours). We are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.


Nice-to-have:


  • Experience with Next.js or Remix for production-grade full-stack React frameworks.
  • Familiarity with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) alongside MongoDB.
  • Experience with vector databases or AI model integration into Node.js backend services.
  • Exposure to micro-frontends or monorepo setups (Turborepo, Nx).



Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and deploy scalable full-stack features from initial database schema creation down to polished, pixel-perfect React interfaces.
  • Build secure, high-concurrency microservices and web services, managing integrations with third-party APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication channels.
  • Audit, profile, and optimize application throughput—reducing bundle sizes and rendering overhead on the front end while optimizing database queries and caching layers (Redis) on the back end.
  • Lead architectural discussions, write modular and well-documented TypeScript code, enforce strict testing protocols, and conduct thorough peer code reviews.
  • Collaborate with cloud and DevOps engineers to containerize applications, set up automated deployment pipelines, and maintain system monitoring tools.



What we offer:


Get paid, not played

No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments with flexible withdrawal options.


Predictable project hours

Enjoy a harmonious work-life balance with consistent 8-hour working days with clients.


Flex days, so you can recharge

Enjoy up to 24 flex days off per year without losing pay, for full-time positions found through Proxify.


Career-accelerating positions at cutting-edge companies

Discover exclusive long-term remote positions at the world's most exciting companies.


Hand-picked opportunities, just for you

Skip the typical recruitment roadblocks and biases with personally matched positions.


One seamless process, multiple opportunities

A one-time contracting process for endless opportunities, with no extra assessments.


Compensation

Enjoy the same pay, every month with positions landed through Proxify.
